_doc: Public sample corpus manifest (serving-hardening P0, decision D8 as modified
by the 2026-07-30 review addendum): a deliberately REDUCED, licence-clean
reference set - NOT a full city. Two sections:
reference_artifacts - enveloped artifacts that are licence-clean under the
FULL encumbrance rules of scripts/nvdm-encumbrance-report.py: every
non-methodology source gov-attribution or clean-open AND clean status
propagated recursively through provenance.internal_inputs (validator
taint semantics - undeclared derived/gee/mixed lineage is never clean;
source-empty artifacts are clean only with an explicit audited
provenance.rights_basis, since produced_by is accountability, not a
rights grant). These are the NVDM public reference artifacts and stay
redistributable in a cold public clone after the P2 cutover.
build_fixtures - files npm run build / npm test cannot pass without, which
are NOT provably licence-clean today (share-alike OSM lineage, or not
yet enveloped so their licence position is unrecorded). Each entry
documents the encumbrance and the decision. They are NOT part of the
licence-clean reference set; including one silently (without an entry
here) fails CI.
PR #221 review round 1 shrank the reference set 28 -> 18: the lineage-aware
audit demoted facts-madurai, restoration-priority-delhi and ward-risk-delhi
(share-alike via OSM-derived internal inputs), the empty-source claim
compilations (restoration-projects/river-events/water-bodies-flagship/
water-bodies-lost-madurai and madurai-water-bodies-lost.geojson - licence
rests on unaudited per-record citations), and the gee/derived artifacts
with undeclared lineage (pallikaranai rich-body trends + buffer,
chennai-coastal-transects). Round 2 (18 -> 17): OpenCity's dataset-page
'open' label is generic portal access language, vague until counsel rules
on it (counsel brief Q5) - facts-delhi, delhi-wards-2022.geojson and
delhi-gwr-blocks.geojson dropped; bangalore-wards-2025.geojson and
chennai-gwr-blocks.geojson replace the geometry exemplars. Round 3
(17 -> 15): produced_by is accountability, not a rights grant, so
source-empty artifacts now need an explicit audited rights_basis -
chennai-water-bodies-lost.geojson (per-feature citations, no rights
claim) drops to vague, and gee-phase1-water-body-targets-madurai drops to
share-alike after its envelope was corrected to the truth (derived from
restoration-priority-madurai, whose rows it copies verbatim). Nothing was
substituted for them: a smaller honest sample beats a padded one.
Contracts / layer types with deliberately NO clean reference exemplar
today: facts (every facts-* file rests on an OpenCity label, an NC survey,
a (c) report or OSM lineage), restoration-priority and
water-bodies-current (OSM lineage), water-bodies-lost (per-record
citations only), and the gee target manifests (share-alike lineage).
Validated by scripts/check-sample-corpus.py: reference artifacts must stay
clean as envelopes evolve; fixtures must match their recorded status (a
fixture that becomes clean must be promoted, one that degrades to NC or
restricted fails). The sample-corpus CI job prunes the corpus to this
manifest and runs npm run build + npm test against it - coverage is proven
by the build.

build_fixtures.required_by: next build (src/lib server read at build time)
build_fixtures.decision: retained as a fixture, NOT promoted: enveloped 2026-07-31 and the envelope is what disqualifies it. 195 of its 200 ward-to-zone rows are still the Zone_No/Zone_Name attributes of the pre-delimitation 2011 ward layer that shipped in the initial commit, whose distributing publisher and licence were never recorded (the open #207 question), so the lineage is unproven rather than government-clean. The other five were corrected 2026-07-31 from the GCC GIS service, which publishes no explicit licence either. Vague is the honest bucket; re-decide if #207's provenance question is ever closed
